universal_lens: Finite-width neural networks exhibit criticality via rescaled couplings and multi-modal geometry, while large deviations govern rare event trajectories through exponential tilting. Vector calculus and electromagnetic field theory underpin structured data inference in GSI through solenoid magnetic flux density equations and Newtonian mechanics for player acceleration modeling.
gsi_mapping: GSI leverages large deviation principles for real-time anomaly detection and conformal prediction of clinical/biometric drift using NTK-based Gaussian processes. Bayesian conformal prediction leverages vector field divergence and curl operators from Maxwell's equations to model uncertainty in real-time sports data streams using magnetic flux density B = μ₀μᵣnI as a probabilistic kernel.
gse_mapping: GSE models game dynamics through tilted trajectories and persistent one-sided excursions, enabling predictive state transitions in NFL/NBA snap-by-snap analysis. Situational reasoning in GSE employs free-body diagrams and friction models (F_net = ma) to simulate player movement dynamics, integrating acceleration vectors and cut angles θ into predictive state transitions.

primitives.name: Neural Tangent Kernel Gaussian Process
primitives.verbatim_quote: **Infinite-Width Models Cannot Learn Representations (`Roberts & Yaida, 2106.10165v2.pdf`):** - In the infinite-width limit ($n \to \infty$, aspect ratio $r \equiv L/n \to 0$), any multilayer neural network reduces to a **Gaussian Process with a frozen Neural Tangent Kernel (`NTK`, $\Theta^{(L)}$)**.
primitives.latex: \Theta^{(L)} = \frac{\partial f(x; W)}{\partial W} \cdot \frac{\partial f(x'; W)}{\partial W}
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'f(x; W)': 'network output, dimensionless', 'W': 'weights, units of inverse activation', "x, x'": 'input vectors, dimensionless', '\\Theta^{(L)}': 'Neural Tangent Kernel, units of variance per weight'}
primitives.assumptions: Infinite-width limit; weights are initialized randomly and remain frozen during training.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Valid only in the infinite-width limit; finite-width corrections are non-perturbative.

layer2.mapping: Enables GSI to model learning dynamics as Gaussian process evolution over NTK-induced feature space.
layer2.telemetry: Kernel matrix $\Theta^{(L)}$ evaluated at input pairs for GP regression.
